+	instances        = make(map[string]interface{})
+	getOrCreateC     = make(chan *entry, 1)
+	genericInstances sync.Map
 )
 
+type genericEntry struct {
+	once  sync.Once
+	value interface{}
+}
+
+// GetInstance returns the singleton for T, creating it with constructor on the
+// first call. A value type and its pointer type have separate instances.
+func GetInstance[T any](constructor func() T) T {
+	typ := reflect.TypeOf((*T)(nil)).Elem()
+	actual, _ := genericInstances.LoadOrStore(typ, &genericEntry{})
+	e := actual.(*genericEntry)
+	e.once.Do(func() {
+		value := constructor()
+		e.value = &value
+	})
+	return *e.value.(*T)
+}

item.text:
Added `singleton.GetInstance[T](constructor)` in [singleton.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton.go). It returns the concrete type, caches value and pointer types separately, and runs the constructor once per type even under concurrent calls.

Added [tests](/app/utils/singleton/singleton_generic_test.go) covering reuse, type separation, and 20,000 concurrent callers. The singleton tests pass with the race detector.
